blocked_sentences: Disguise {4}{G} (You may cast this card face down for {3} as a 2/2 creature with ward {2}. Turn it face up any time for its disguise cost.)

needs.what: the disguise alternative cast (702.168): cast face down for {3} as a 2/2 colourless nameless creature that has ward {2}, turnable face up for the printed disguise cost as a special action
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `morph` in card_level_cost_keys gives the face-down {3} 2/2 and the turn-face-up action, but its face-down characteristics carry no abilities, so a disguised permanent would lack ward {2}; the ward {2} the engine supplies to a face-down shell exists only for cloak (a flag on the `manifest` op), not for a card cast face down. The trigger line itself is expressible (`turned_face_up` with controller you, `add_counters` amount `power_of` the subject).
